title: Mockito & Test Doubles
intro: Mockito (fresher level) introduces mocking for unit tests. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with what mocking is (the motivation — isolating the unit under test), then Mockito setup and the when/thenReturn stubbing pattern. Verify (the interaction assertion) and argument matchers follow at the mechanics tier, then mock vs stub vs spy (the test-double taxonomy). InjectMocks and testing Spring services close the module at the applied tier.
